promised_vs_delivered.delivered: No final commercialized molecule count was given in FY27 calls, though new molecules generated 16-18% of AgChem export revenue.
Target to achieve Rs 500-600 crore top line in pharma is set for a couple of years out.
Full year FY26 OPM reached 25.8% with operating profit of Rs 1,732 crore on Rs 6,714 crore revenue.
Standard capex guidance of Rs 700-800 crore is undergoing implementation across FY27.
Effective tax rate guidance of around 24% applies to full fiscal year FY27.
Targeting $100 million revenue in specialty chemicals within a 3-4 year timeframe from Q2 FY27.
Long-term margin guidance of 50%-52% remains targeted across upcoming periods.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlights resilient FY26 performance achieving its full-year EBITDA margin target of 25%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 OPM reached 25.8% on Rs 1,732 crore operating profit and Rs 6,714 crore revenue.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlights working capital improvement, stating a reduction of 18 to 19 days releasing INR 300 crore.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Cycle days fell to 45.1 days in FY25 before rising to 83.1 days in FY26, with debtor days increasing to 82.0 days.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management points to 19% growth in domestic agri business and 45% growth in domestic biologicals.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue fell 9.1% YoY to Rs 1,702 crore, with PAT dropping 70.2% YoY to Rs 122 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported 40% growth in Pharma for FY26 and 20% YoY growth in Q2 FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Total revenue contracted 15.8% in FY26 to Rs 6,714 crore and fell 9.1% YoY in Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Zero net debt balance sheet maintained with net debt to EBITDA of -1.062 and debt-to-equity ratio at 0.03 in FY26.
Pharma business expanded rapidly, delivering 40% growth in FY26 and 20% YoY growth in Q2 FY27.
Long-term cash generation remains solid with a 5-year cash conversion ratio of 88.4% and 5-year PAT CAGR of 12.3%.

bear.point: FY26 revenue dropped 15.8% to Rs 6,714 crore while free cash flow turned negative at -Rs 632 crore.
Q2 FY27 profitability fell sharply with OPM dropping to 13.7% and PAT declining 70.2% YoY to Rs 122 crore.
AgChem exports declined by 18% in Q2 FY27 due to pricing pressure and unpassed cost escalation.

watch.point: Recovery in AgChem export volumes and ability to pass on unpassed cost escalations.
Margin trajectory in Q3 FY27 following OPM contraction to 13.7% in Q2 FY27.
Execution of FY27 planned capex of Rs 700 to Rs 800 crore and subsidiary break-even timeline.
